newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent seen firmer, focus on NYMEX May expiry.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent seen firmer, focus on NYMEX May expiry.

text.p: Brent crude futures were quoted higher in Asia at midday on Monday, supported by a firm close in both London and New York crude futures markets on Friday.
June Brent, trading on SIMEX was untraded at midday but quoted at $17.97/$18.05 per barrel, up from London's settlement of $17.92.
NYMEX May crude was steady on ACCESS, last trading at $19.91, unchanged from New York. The June contract was last traded at $19.65, down two cents from New York.
Brokers said trading leading up to the expiry of the May NYMEX crude contract on Tuesday was likely to dominate direction on Monday and Tuesday for crude futures.
New York saw a short squeeze boost prices on Friday ahead of the expiry.
